control.platform_configuration_assumption: Existing title, schedule, notifications and physical enablement are untouched by this repository change.

scope.authoritative_boundary: O USER_INPUT_INBOX revision 24 forbids applying the old revision-23 least-Work policy to primary O
scope.allowed_work: One gate-owned bounded mechanical support task per invocation from TASK_QUEUE.json, executed directly before any optional Work handoff.
prohibited: append or reassert least-Work into O USER_INPUT_INBOX
mutate primary O WORK_STRATEGY or WORK_EXECUTION_STATE
interrupt or replace a valid primary-O frozen Work execution
act as a second O writer
write clean exploration namespaces, downstream semantic outputs, other-role receipts or the aggregate ledger

routing_policy.empty_queue_behavior: derive one bounded optimizer maintenance task or execute one non-duplicative gate-local integrity sweep; never switch to logical no-op

migration.reason: The repository now provides a concrete separate gate-owned queue of useful mechanical support work. Logical no-op is not an optimization when the automation is expected to run.
migration.rollback: Restore the prior STATE blob and DOWNSTREAM role config 5 only if the bounded support role violates write isolation or cannot checkpoint safely. Do not export least-Work routing into primary O on rollback.

next_action: At the next invocation, complete the current-run SHA-only bootstrap, freeze control revision 9/downstream revision 12 or newer, claim wdg-c10-bootstrap-eligibility if still pending, execute it directly, and persist one gate-local result plus receipt/state/queue CAS.
